title: Replies and reactions — answer a post, and say "Yasher koach"

tasks.title: Replies and Yasher koach, API and interface

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer calls `POST /api/v1/posts/{postId}/replies` with `{body}` (1–1,000 characters after trimming) THE SYSTEM SHALL store the reply under the post, authored by the viewer's own profile, and answer 201 with the reply; a reply to an unknown or deleted post answers 404 `post.not_found`, an empty or too-long body 400 `request.invalid`. WHEN the reply's author calls `DELETE /api/v1/replies/{replyId}` THE SYSTEM SHALL remove it and answer 204; anyone else answers 403 `reply.forbidden`. The post's reply count (spec 023) counts its replies.
scenarios: AC-001 replying to a post and deleting the reply

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer calls `PUT /api/v1/posts/{postId}/reaction` THE SYSTEM SHALL record one reaction of that viewer on the post (calling it again changes nothing) and answer 200 with the post's reaction count and `reacted: true`; `DELETE` on the same path removes it and answers 200 with `reacted: false`; an unknown post answers 404 `post.not_found`.
scenarios: AC-002 reacting is idempotent and reversible

acs.text: WHEN a viewer presses a post's "Yasher koach" button THE SYSTEM SHALL show the new state and count at once (before the server answers), restore the previous state and announce the failure if the server refuses, and mark the pressed state with an icon change and `aria-pressed`, never with colour alone; the count uses tabular figures so it does not shift.
scenarios: AC-003 Yasher koach updates at once and rolls back on failure

acs.text: WHEN a viewer opens `/social/p/$postId` THE SYSTEM SHALL list the post's replies under it, oldest first, each with its author, relative time and body, and a reply box with a "Reply" button; a sent reply appears at the end of the list at once and the post's reply count goes up; the reply's author sees a "Delete" action on it. In the timeline each post shows its reply count as a link to its page.
scenarios: AC-004 replies on the post page
